newsitem.title: USA: Rubin agrees with Japan concern on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Rubin agrees with Japan concern on weak yen.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin reiterated on Sunday that he agreed with Japan's recently expressed concern about the weakness of the yen.

"I did agree with the finance minister of Japan when he and his officials said that they were concerned about the recent movements -- and their movements have been to a weakness -- of the yen," he said in an interview on the ABC television broadcast "This Week."

"We continue to believe that our policy with respect to the dollar is correct. On the other hand, we also think that it is not advantageous to us or the world trading economy to have other currencies get out of sync with their economic fundamentals," Rubin said.

Tokyo has expressed serious concern about the recent weakness of the yen. Last week, top officials from the Group of Seven leading industrial nations warned against the dangers of big shifts in currency rates that they said could hurt world trade.
